listening.title: A video interview for a QA engineer position

lines.speaker: Linh (HR Recruiter)
lines.text: Good morning, Đức. Before we start, let's do a quick audio check. Can you hear me clearly?

lines.speaker: Đức (Candidate)
lines.text: Good morning, Linh. Yes, I can hear you very well. Can you hear me?

lines.speaker: Linh (HR Recruiter)
lines.text: Yes, perfectly. Today is a panel interview, so Mr. Nam from the QA team is also joining.

lines.speaker: Nam (QA Lead)
lines.text: Hello Đức, nice to meet you. Could you start by telling us about your testing experience?

lines.speaker: Đức (Candidate)
lines.text: Sure. I have three years of experience in manual and automation testing for mobile banking apps.

lines.speaker: Linh (HR Recruiter)
lines.text: Sorry Đức, your video was frozen for a moment. Could you repeat the last part?

lines.speaker: Đức (Candidate)
lines.text: Of course. I have three years of experience in testing mobile banking apps. If the connection drops again, I can switch to my phone's hotspot.

lines.speaker: Nam (QA Lead)
lines.text: Thanks, that's good preparation. It's clear now.

lines.speaker: Linh (HR Recruiter)
lines.text: I noticed you joined five minutes early. We appreciate that.

lines.speaker: Đức (Candidate)
lines.text: Thank you. I did a test call last night to check my camera and microphone, so I felt more confident today.
